notes:
POC focus: run Redwood Private inside customer VPC with Terraform + Helm. Customer expects full KMS (HSM-backed) integration, audit logs forwarded to Splunk, and strict US-only data residency. Wants SSO via Okta (SAML).

Key customer quotes / paraphrases: "We cannot accept data plane egress except to approved monitoring endpoints." CTO emphasized latency SLOs for production (p95 < 120ms at 100 qps).

Success criteria (POC): automated Terraform apply + Helm deploy in dev VPC; e2e inference at sustained 100 qps with target latency; KMS envelope key creation and rotation validated; audit logs searchable in Splunk and retained per policy; security sign-off from infra + compliance.

Implementation notes: Redwood provides Terraform modules, Helm charts, runbooks, and a test harness. Customer provides AWS account, VPC CIDR ranges, CMK, and Splunk HEC token. SE to deliver sample TF module and values file.

Risks / open items: legal must approve KMS key policy (cross-account use); network team needs to finalize egress allowlist; confirmation on retention window (90 vs 365 days). Budget: willing to consider reserved Dedicated if POC meets SLOs.

Quick action items: send updated KMS policy template (SE), schedule sign-off meeting week of 2025-02-24 (AE), finalize SOW & ARR after sign-off.
